entities.summary: Xavier Allen Alexander, nicknamed "X-Man", is an American professional basketball player who last played for Tangerang Hawks of the Indonesian Basketball League (IBL). He played college basketball for George Washington Revolutionaries and Southern Nazarene Crimson Storm.
